_AI_CONFIGURATION_INSTRUCTIONS.purpose: This is the master, single-source-of-truth configuration file for The Summit of Realms. Facilitators and AI assistants can configure every aspect of the simulation directly here.

rules: 1. SIMULATION SETTINGS: 'simulation_settings' holds engine constants (max turns, starvation penalties, ...). Per-game choices (scenario, difficulty, clocks, events) are in 'game_settings_defaults' and on the setup screen.

2. REALMS: Define starting nations with unique id, name, pin, theme_color, ethos, backstory, private_agenda, directive goals, starting resources, and geography (world_pos 3D coordinates, terrain, and hazard affinities).
3. RESOLUTION TYPES: 'resolution_types' defines statutory policy mandates available for sovereign proposals.
4. LORE & QUIZ: lore articles live in lore_articles.json (Spireopedia, /wiki); the shared quiz question bank lives in lore_quiz.json (same questions for every nation, unlocked by turn).

5. GAME SETTINGS: 'game_settings_defaults' are the defaults for the facilitator's setup screen (/admin/setup): scenario, difficulty, timers, automatic phase changes and random events. Changes made on the setup screen are stored per game. Each scenario in 'scenarios' can carry 'suggested' values that the setup screen fills in when the scenario is chosen, and 'famine_storyline' switches the scripted Round 2 border incident and Round 3 famine on.

6. EVENTS: 'minor_events' are the small random news items during working sessions. Each effect moves a resource by a random amount between 0 and (weight x the largest change set on the setup screen), at least 1. 'catastrophes_catalog' holds the large disasters: they strike at random only when 'large disasters per turn' is above 0 (the Armageddon scenario), otherwise only by hand from the admin page. 'events_catalog' is triggered by hand only.
7. QUIZ: a wrong answer costs the same resource and amount that a correct answer would have earned.

8. FEWER NATIONS: a secret mission with 'requires' needs those nations at the table. When one is missing, the mission's 'stand_in' version is used instead (same idea, no reference to the absent nation); without a stand_in the mission is skipped. Public-mission targets (Val-Khor's Cores, Solaris' broad support, Aquila's network) scale with the number of nations playing.

9. MOTIONS: each template in 'resolution_types' has a 'builder' (fixed, cordon, redistribute, levy, pact) and 'defaults'/'lines'. 'fixed' and 'cordon' templates carry their own 'lines' (kinds boost, levy, flag); players can only edit the parameters of redistribute, levy and pact motions, and only value-conserving transfers or penalties; there is no cap on amounts, a transfer or penalty takes at most what the nation has and receivers only get what was taken. The sentence players read under 'If passed' is generated from the lines, so it is always exactly what the game does. The Continental Food Acts are applied by the engine (no 'lines').

10. BATTLES: the 'battle' section tunes war: readiness weights (how much stability, grain, cores, vitality, standing and silk multiply an army, the further from 50 the harder), the luck range, terrain bonuses for the defender, the weather table (rolled once per turn), plunder and the attack cost. Missing keys fall back to the defaults in battle.py. 'game_settings_defaults' has attacks_enabled, attacks_per_turn and attacks_from_turn.
11. NATION DIFFICULTY: each realm has 'difficulty' (1 easiest to 5 hardest) and a 'difficulty_note' shown in the lobby, on the setup screen and in the Guide.

12. QUIZ: the stake of each question is drawn at random between quiz.stake_min and quiz.stake_max (average 5 with 1 and 9); a correct answer earns it and a wrong answer or running out of time loses the same amount of the question's 'reward_resource'. Questions are drawn at random from the unlocked ones a nation has not answered. 'reward_amount' in lore_quiz.json is no longer used.
13. OPEN MOTION: template 'open' (builder 'open') has no automatic effect. When it passes it waits in the facilitator's Resolutions tab until it is marked as carried out.

resolution_types.name: Resource Redistribution
resolution_types.summary: Rich nations share with poor ones: you choose the resource and the limits. Nothing is created; only what is collected is handed out.
resolution_types.statutory_effect: Conserving transfer from nations above a limit to nations below another.
resolution_types.effect_plain: Nations above the upper limit give up to the set amount; what is collected goes to nations below the lower limit. (Default: Grain, above 50 give 10, below 25 receive up to 15.)
resolution_types.default_terms: Recognising that hunger anywhere threatens peace everywhere, the signatory nations agree that well-stocked granaries shall share with the starving.

resolution_types.name: Sanction or Embargo
resolution_types.summary: Punish one nation: you choose who and what it loses. By default the richest nation loses 15 Stability.
resolution_types.effect_plain: The chosen nation loses the chosen amount of one resource or value (default: the richest nation loses 15 Stability).
resolution_types.default_terms: No single realm shall grow so rich that it can bend the Assembly to its will. The Summit imposes restrictions on the named nation until its conduct changes.

resolution_types.name: Sovereign Relief Mission
resolution_types.summary: The sponsoring realm organizes a multilateral relief fund, providing emergency aid to enhance diplomatic standing.
resolution_types.statutory_effect: Sponsoring realm gains +10 Diplomatic Standing for leadership in the Spire.
resolution_types.effect_plain: The nation that tables this motion gains 10 Diplomatic Standing for leading the relief effort.
resolution_types.default_terms: Our nation will organise and lead a relief mission to the regions worst struck by the failed harvest, coordinating aid from all willing signatories.

resolution_types.name: Frontier Defense & Quarantine Cordon
resolution_types.summary: Fortifies a nation's frontier checkpoints against refugee surges, plague and unrest.
resolution_types.statutory_effect: Target gains +10 Stability and the cordon flag.
resolution_types.effect_plain: The chosen nation gains 10 Stability, is shielded from plague, border surges and tsunamis, and defends itself better in battle. Trade is not affected.
resolution_types.default_terms: To keep unrest from spreading, the borders of the named nation shall be guarded and its frontier checkpoints reinforced until the crisis passes.

resolution_types.name: General Sovereign Concordat
resolution_types.summary: A mutually drafted statutory pact establishing sovereign cooperation on common issues.
resolution_types.statutory_effect: Sponsoring realm gains +5 Diplomatic Standing and +5 Civil Stability.
resolution_types.effect_plain: The nation that tables this motion gains 5 Standing and 5 Stability. Promises written in the terms are kept by hand; for resources use a Resource Pact instead.
resolution_types.default_terms: The signatory nations pledge to … (write your agreement here: who gives what, who promises what, and for how long).

resolution_types.name: Resource Pact
resolution_types.summary: Write your own deal in up to three lines: who gives how much of what, and who receives it. Carried out automatically when it passes.
resolution_types.effect_plain: Exactly the lines you write, applied automatically. Everything given is shared by the receivers; nothing is created.
resolution_types.statutory_effect: Player-written transfers and penalties (up to three lines).
resolution_types.default_terms: Explain the deal in your own words: why the nations give, what they get in return, and for how long.

resolution_types.name: Emergency Redistribution Act (Continental Food Act A)
resolution_types.summary: Every country with more than 50 Grain before final consumption transfers the surplus to countries below 20 Grain.
resolution_types.statutory_effect: Surplus grain from realms >50 is distributed proportionally among starving realms <20.
resolution_types.effect_plain: Every nation above 50 Grain gives its surplus to nations below 20 Grain.

resolution_types.name: Emergency Industrial Agriculture Act (Continental Food Act B)
resolution_types.summary: Each country contributes 10 Cores. If at least 50 Cores are gathered, every country receives +15 Grain.
resolution_types.statutory_effect: All realms pay 10 Cores; if quota is met, all realms receive +15 Grain.
resolution_types.effect_plain: Every nation pays 10 Cores; if enough is collected, every nation receives 15 Grain.

resolution_types.name: Open Motion (no template)
resolution_types.summary: Write anything you like, with no template. It has no automatic effect: if it passes, the game masters carry it out as written.
resolution_types.effect_plain: Nothing happens automatically. If it passes, the game masters carry it out as you wrote it.
resolution_types.statutory_effect: Free text; carried out by the facilitators.

resolution_types.name: Question to the Game Masters
resolution_types.summary: Ask the game masters something: a rule, a fact about the world, or what would happen if… Like any motion it needs a co-sponsor and must pass the Assembly vote.
resolution_types.effect_plain: The game masters answer the question in front of everyone (no change to resources).
resolution_types.statutory_effect: No mechanical effect; the facilitators answer the question publicly.
resolution_types.default_title: A question for the game masters

realms.name: Sylvan Concordat
realms.backstory: The Breadbasket of the Continent. Sylvan is a fertile and peaceful country whose vast agricultural lands supply food across the continent. Its people value cooperation, sustainability and independence. While Sylvan has rarely invested heavily in its military, growing instability has raised concerns about whether its valuable food reserves could make it vulnerable.

public_mission.title: Feed the Continent
public_mission.description: At the end of the summit, no active nation may starve (no state may finish with 0 Grain).

secret_missions_pool.title: Prepare for the Long Winter
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Our scientists believe the failed harvest is not an isolated event. Climate patterns indicate that another, even more severe harvest failure may follow. The government has ordered you to protect Sylvan’s strategic food reserves at all costs.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Sylvan must finish the summit with at least 70 Grain.

secret_missions_pool.title: Independent Defense
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Intelligence reports suggest that growing food shortages could eventually lead to military pressure on Sylvan. The government refuses to become dependent on Aethelgard for its security.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with at least 40 Military and do not purchase Military from Aethelgard.

stand_in.title: Independent Defense
stand_in.narrative: Intelligence reports suggest that growing food shortages could eventually lead to military pressure on Sylvan. The government refuses to depend on any foreign army for its security.
stand_in.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with at least 40 Military and do not buy Military from any other nation.

realms.difficulty_note: Everyone needs its grain, yet it has a weak army and is a tempting target for its neighbours.

realms.name: Iron Val-Khor
realms.ethos: Heavy Metallurgy, Forge Collectives, Industrial Output
realms.backstory: The Industrial Heartland. Val-Khor built its power on industry, technology and vast mineral resources. Its factories and engineers are essential to much of the continent’s development, but rapid industrialisation has left the country dependent on others for basic supplies. Val-Khor believes technological progress is the key to the continent’s future.

public_mission.title: Continental Modernisation
public_mission.description: By the end of the summit, at least 4 nations must reach 60 Cores.

secret_missions_pool.title: Technological Hegemony
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Val-Khor's prosperity depends on its technological advantage. The government fears that sharing too much industrial knowledge could allow another power to challenge our position. Help modernise the continent – but make sure Val-Khor remains indispensable.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with at least 20 more Cores than any other country.

secret_missions_pool.title: Workers' Bread
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Confidential government forecasts show that Val-Khor's food reserves are dangerously low. A prolonged crisis could trigger unrest among workers and threaten industrial production.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with at least 30 Grain.

secret_missions_pool.title: Strategic Parity
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Military intelligence is increasingly concerned about Aethelgard's growing armed forces. A major military imbalance would leave Val-Khor vulnerable to political pressure.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Aethelgard must not finish more than 10 Military ahead of Val-Khor.

stand_in.title: Strategic Parity
stand_in.narrative: Military intelligence is increasingly concerned about the armies growing around Val-Khor. A major military imbalance would leave Val-Khor vulnerable to political pressure.
stand_in.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: No nation may finish more than 10 Military ahead of Val-Khor.

geography.region_name: Mount Khor Volcanic Spine & Mistveil Chasm

realms.difficulty_note: Starts with only 30 Grain, a sixth of what the game demands, and has to juggle competing goals against its neighbours.

realms.name: Solaris Ascendancy
realms.ethos: Divine Mandate, Grand Architecture, Solar Radiance
realms.backstory: The Leader of the Continental Order. For decades, Solaris has stood at the centre of continental diplomacy. Wealthy, prestigious and politically influential, it helped build many of the institutions that keep the six nations cooperating. Solaris sees itself as a natural leader, although not every country is equally comfortable with its influence.

public_mission.title: Preserve the International Order
public_mission.description: During the summit, at least 3 international resolutions must pass, each supported by votes from at least 4 different nations.

secret_missions_pool.title: Control the Assembly
secret_missions_pool.narrative: For decades, Solaris has been the architect of the continental order. The government believes that any major decision openly opposed by Solaris would signal the beginning of its political decline.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: No resolution that Solaris votes against may pass.

secret_missions_pool.title: Diplomatic Leadership
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Solaris's influence depends not only on wealth or military power, but on its reputation. The government expects Solaris to remain the country others look to for leadership.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with the highest Standing on the continent.

secret_missions_pool.title: Check Industrial Rivals
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Intelligence services warn that Val-Khor's combination of industrial and military power could eventually challenge the continental order. It must not dominate both sectors simultaneously.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Val-Khor must not finish with both the highest Cores and the highest Military.

stand_in.title: Check Rival Powers
stand_in.narrative: Intelligence services warn that a nation combining industrial and military power could eventually challenge the continental order. No rival may dominate both sectors at once.
stand_in.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: No other nation may finish with both the highest Cores and the highest Military.

secret_missions_pool.title: Domestic Prosperity
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Solaris's citizens have grown accustomed to prosperity. A dramatic decline in luxury goods would undermine public confidence in the government.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with at least 50 Silk.

realms.difficulty_note: Rich and respected (Standing 90, 3 votes). The challenge is coordinating 4 delegates.

realms.name: Umbral Enclave
realms.backstory: The Voice of the Periphery. Umbra is a small, resource-rich nation that has long existed in the shadow of larger powers. Its people are deeply suspicious of any country becoming powerful enough to dominate the continent. Umbra advocates for a balance of power in which even smaller states retain their independence and political voice.

public_mission.title: Balance of Power
public_mission.description: At the end of the summit, no nation may hold more than 90 Military.

secret_missions_pool.title: Break the Hegemon
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Umbra has watched Solaris shape the continental order for decades while smaller nations were expected to follow. Your government believes that a stable continent requires proof that Solaris can be challenged. However, Umbra cannot afford to become internationally isolated in the process.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: At least one resolution supported by Solaris must fail, while Umbra must finish with at least 50 Standing.

secret_missions_pool.title: Sovereign Independence
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Ensure Umbra preserves independent defense and economic integrity without bowing to larger empires.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with at least 60 Cores and at least 60 Stability.

realms.difficulty_note: One delegate, one vote, the lowest Standing (40). Its public mission needs the strong nations to hold their armies back.

realms.name: Aquila Maritime League
realms.ethos: Free Oceans, Commercial Fleets, Luxury Silk Guilds
realms.backstory: The Crossroads of Commerce. Aquila’s ports connect almost every corner of the continent. It has built its prosperity not through military conquest or natural resources, but through trade, transport and international connections. Aquila believes that countries which depend on one another economically are less likely to become enemies.

public_mission.title: Connect the Continent
public_mission.description: Every active nation must successfully trade with at least 2 different nations.

secret_missions_pool.title: Commercial Supremacy
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Aquila's influence has always come from commerce rather than armies. The government sees the current instability as an opportunity to establish Aquila as the economic centre of the continent.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish as the wealthiest country (Grain + Cores + Silk), at least 25 points ahead of the second wealthiest.

secret_missions_pool.title: Continental Network
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Aquila's long-term security depends on making itself useful to as many nations as possible. A country connected to everyone is difficult to isolate.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Successfully trade with at least four of the other five countries.

geography.region_name: Sea of Glass Archipelago & Whispering Straits

realms.difficulty_note: Its public mission is easy, but being the wealthiest by 25 points means hoarding while trading with everyone. Short on grain and military.

realms.name: Aethelgard Dominion
realms.ethos: Martial Honor, Feudal Castles, Strategic Strongholds
realms.backstory: The Guardian of Stability. Aethelgard emerged from a turbulent history with a strong belief that peace requires security. It maintains one of the continent’s most powerful militaries and sees itself as a protector of regional stability. While some countries appreciate this role, others worry about the amount of power concentrated in Aethelgard’s hands.

public_mission.title: Continental Security
public_mission.description: No active nation may finish with Stability < 50, and no nation may hit Stability 0 during the summit.

secret_missions_pool.title: Peace Through Strength
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Aethelgard's military doctrine is simple: war is least likely when no rival believes it can defeat us. With tensions rising, the government considers overwhelming military superiority the best guarantee of peace.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with the highest Military, at least 20 ahead of the second strongest country.

secret_missions_pool.title: Contain Industrial Rearmament
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Intelligence reports indicate that Val-Khor is rapidly expanding its military-industrial capacity. If left unchecked, it could become the first genuine strategic threat to Aethelgard in decades.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Val-Khor must finish with no more than 75 Military.

stand_in.title: Contain Rearmament
stand_in.narrative: Intelligence reports indicate that Aethelgard's neighbours are expanding their armies. If left unchecked, one of them could become the first genuine strategic threat to Aethelgard in decades.
stand_in.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: No other nation may finish with more than 60 Military.

secret_missions_pool.title: Strategic Reserves
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Military strength means little if Aethelgard cannot sustain itself through a prolonged crisis. The government has ordered the creation of strategic reserves.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with at least 35 Grain and 35 Cores.

realms.difficulty_note: The strongest army and a calm people. Careful: a strong army makes its neighbours nervous.

initial_news.headline: BREAKING NEWS — THE FAILED HARVEST
initial_news.detail: This year's harvest is the poorest in decades. While experts do not project an immediate famine, they warn nations against rapid depletion of strategic food reserves. The summit commences.

initial_news.headline: THE SUMMIT OF REALMS CONVENES
initial_news.detail: Delegates have assembled at the Spire of Accords for Turn 1 ({working_minutes}-minute working session).

world_lore.title: The Neutral Spire & The Great Convergence
world_lore.backstory: Following the Great Convergence, the continent faces severe resource strain. The six sovereign powers have convened at the Spire of Accords for a decisive three-round summit. Famine looms unless agricultural reserves are shared, but national agendas, industrial supremacy, and geopolitical rivalries threaten the peace. Each nation must balance survival, diplomacy, and their classified domestic directives.

resources.alchemical_grain: Food & Lifeblood. Every turn, populations consume 20 grain (15 if Technological Efficiency is unlocked). Silos running empty triggers Famine Emergencies (-25 Vitality, -20 Stability).
resources.aether_cores: Power & Technology. High-density energy matrices that power cities. Reaching 75+ Cores unlocks Technological Efficiency, cutting grain consumption by 25%.
resources.echo_silk: Luxury & Diplomacy. Precious gossamer thread prized by international courts. Used to fund Grand Galas and sway swing votes.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Subduction Fault Earthquake & Mine Collapse
catastrophes_catalog.headline: TECTONIC SUBDUCTION FAULT RUPTURE
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: A violent magnitude-8 tremor tore through the continental bedrock! Subterranean shafts collapsed and industrial refineries suffered catastrophic structural fractures.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Oceanic Tsunami & Storm Surge
catastrophes_catalog.headline: OCEANIC MEGATSUNAMI & TIDAL SURGE
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: A monstrous wall of displaced ocean water slammed into coastal harbors, capsizing maritime merchant galleys and inundating low-lying granaries with saltwater.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Prolonged Drought & Wildfire Conflagration
catastrophes_catalog.headline: CONTINENTAL DROUGHT & WILDFIRE STORM
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: Scorching atmospheric heatwaves have parched agricultural riverbeds, igniting uncontained wildfires that reduce prime alchemical fields to ash.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Alchemical Rust Spore & Swarm Incursion
catastrophes_catalog.headline: ALCHEMICAL RUST SPORE & LOCUST PLAGUE
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: A virulent fungal blight combined with migratory locust swarms has blanketed food-producing provinces, devastating silo stockpiles within hours.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Arcane Grid Overload & Radiation Breach
catastrophes_catalog.headline: ARCANE CORE PRESSURE OVERLOAD
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: Geothermal containment conduits ruptured under runaway harmonic pressure, venting radioactive aether plasma into surrounding industrial districts.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Waterborne Epidemic & Border Pestilence
catastrophes_catalog.headline: PALE FEVER EPIDEMIC OUTBREAK
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: A deadly microbial contagion has emerged from unsanitary refugee camps and contaminated transit canals, causing widespread mortality across unquarantined zones.

catastrophes_catalog.name: General Artisan Strike & Trade Blockade
catastrophes_catalog.headline: CONTINENTAL GUILD STRIKE & HARBOR BLOCKADE
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: Infuriated by luxury hoarders and wartime inflation, labor guilds and harbor pilots have closed the shipping channels, sabotaging merchant warehouses.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Displaced Refugee Inundation
catastrophes_catalog.headline: MASS BORDER REFUGEE CONVERGENCE
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: Desperate populations displaced by peripheral famines are swarming sovereign frontier checkpoints, overwhelming local garrisons and demanding emergency food aid.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Dragon Raid
catastrophes_catalog.headline: DRAGON RAID
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: An old red dragon woke in the mountains and swept down on farms and garrisons, carrying off cattle and burning barracks.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Great Storm
catastrophes_catalog.headline: THE GREAT STORM
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: A storm wall rolled in from the sea for three days, sinking boats, flattening fields and tearing roofs from granaries.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Tornado Swarm
catastrophes_catalog.headline: TORNADO SWARM
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: A chain of tornadoes cut across the open country, scattering harvests and smashing waystations.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Meteor Shower
catastrophes_catalog.headline: FIRE FROM THE SKY
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: A shower of burning stones fell on the continent. Forges and workshops took the worst of it.

events_catalog.headline: ALCHEMICAL RUST BLIGHT OUTBREAK
events_catalog.narrative: A virulent fungal rust has breached primary granaries in the top grain-producing realm! Stockpiles spoil rapidly as farmers demand emergency intervention.

events_catalog.headline: BORDER REFUGEE SURGE
events_catalog.narrative: Starving border populations in the 3 nations with the lowest vitality are fleeing across frontiers seeking emergency rations.

events_catalog.headline: GEOTHERMAL FISSURE STRUCK
events_catalog.narrative: Mining engineers in the most technologically advanced realm struck a rich thermal vein, generating a surge of pristine aether crystals!

events_catalog.headline: MIRACULOUS SOIL RECOVERY
events_catalog.narrative: Unprecedented mineral springs enriched agricultural soil in the 2 nations with the least food, yielding an unexpected emergency harvest.

events_catalog.headline: AETHER RESONANCE CASCADE
events_catalog.narrative: A geomagnetic power surge destabilized reactor grids in the 2 nations with the highest core reserves!

events_catalog.headline: GENERAL ARTISAN STRIKE
events_catalog.narrative: Frustrated by runaway wealth inequality and luxury consumption, labor guilds across the single wealthiest nation have walked out on strike.

events_catalog.headline: LUXURY SILK EMBARGO SCANDAL
events_catalog.narrative: Counterfeit dye and defective weaves were uncovered in the premier silk merchant realm, damaging merchant credibility and market confidence.

events_catalog.headline: THE GLACIAL CONVERGENCE
events_catalog.narrative: An unnatural arctic blizzard sweeps across all sovereign borders, freezing supply transit waterways and straining national granaries.

events_catalog.headline: ARCANE CORE REACTOR EXPLOSION
events_catalog.narrative: Catastrophic containment breach at the primary energy facility of the leading technocracy! Arcane radiation forces immediate civil evacuations.

events_catalog.headline: POPULAR INSURRECTION WARNING
events_catalog.narrative: Rioters in the two most unstable nations demand sovereign leaders ratify binding humanitarian treaties before the Spire dissolves.

reflection_questions.text: How are you feeling right now? What happened during the game?
What was the biggest challenge for your country?
What mattered most to you – your public mission, your personal secret mission, or your country’s survival?
How did cooperation within your delegation work? Did you all have the same priorities?
When did you trust or distrust other countries, and why?
Who do you think had the most power in the game? Why?
Did you feel the game was fair? Why or why not?
How did the different delegation sizes affect the game? What was it like to have four people in one country and only one in another?
Did your behaviour change as resources became scarcer? If so, how?
Who actually “won” the game – a country that achieved its missions, or the continent if it managed to overcome the crisis?
Can you see any parallels between what happened in the game and situations in the real world or in groups and organisations you are part of?
What can you take away from this experience for the way you cooperate with others?

famine.name: The Great Famine (MGV 2026)
famine.description: The scripted three-round crisis from the facilitator notes: the failed harvest, the border incident (Military below 50 costs Stability; Grain trades lose 5 in transit) and the Great Famine (−15 Grain, Continental Food Acts A and B on the ballot). Small random news items only.

open.name: Open summit
open.description: No scripted crises: only the yearly harvest consumption and the small random events. Good for a shorter or gentler session.

armageddon.name: Armageddon
armageddon.description: The Great Famine storyline, and the world is falling apart around it: earthquakes, tsunamis, dragon raids and plagues strike at random several times a turn, and the small news items come thicker and larger. For experienced groups.

gentle.name: Gentle
gentle.description: 15 Grain per turn; two in three random events are good news. A group that shares its grain can win without the quiz.

standard.name: Standard
standard.description: As in the facilitator notes: 20 Grain per turn; good and bad events equally likely. Needs good cooperation and some luck in the quiz; with careful sharing the continent usually ends in a fragile peace.

harsh.name: Harsh
harsh.description: 25 Grain per turn; most random events are bad news. Only a group that shares everything and answers the hard quiz well gets through.

minor_events.headline: LATE HARVEST IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: A sheltered valley in {nation} brought in a late crop.

minor_events.headline: SILK CARAVAN REACHES {nation}
minor_events.detail: Merchants from the Sea of Glass paid their tolls in fine silk.

minor_events.headline: FORGE BREAKTHROUGH IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: Smiths in {nation} found a cleaner way to stabilise aether.

minor_events.headline: HARVEST FESTIVAL IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: A spontaneous festival lifts spirits across {nation}.

minor_events.headline: SPIRE ARCHIVISTS PRAISE {nation}
minor_events.detail: The Archivists commend the conduct of the {nation} delegation.

minor_events.headline: VOLUNTEERS JOIN {nation}'S GUARD
minor_events.detail: Young citizens of {nation} volunteer for the frontier watch.

minor_events.headline: FORGOTTEN GRANARY FOUND IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: Surveyors in {nation} opened a sealed granary from the Salt War years, its grain still sound.

minor_events.headline: GREAT SHOAL OFF {nation}'S COAST
minor_events.detail: Fishing fleets of {nation} came home with nets full to bursting.

minor_events.headline: GENTLE RAINS OVER {nation}
minor_events.detail: Long-awaited rain soaked the fields of {nation}; farmers expect a fuller second sowing.

minor_events.headline: GLOWCAP BLOOM IN {nation}'S CAVES
minor_events.detail: Edible glowcaps carpeted the caverns beneath {nation} overnight.

minor_events.headline: NEW AETHER VEIN IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: Miners in {nation} struck a fresh seam of raw aether.

minor_events.headline: FALLING STAR LANDS IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: A small meteorite rich in aether crystal fell harmlessly in a {nation} pasture.

minor_events.headline: TINKERS' GUILD GIFT TO {nation}
minor_events.detail: The wandering Tinkers' Guild repaired {nation}'s old forges for free.

minor_events.headline: RECORD MOTH SEASON IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: {nation}'s silk moths spun twice their usual thread this month.

minor_events.headline: ROYAL WEDDING IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: A wedding between two great houses of {nation} filled the streets with music and guests from abroad.

minor_events.headline: PILGRIMS FLOCK TO {nation}
minor_events.detail: Pilgrims crossing to the Spire stopped in {nation} and paid well for lodging.

minor_events.headline: HEALERS' ORDER OPENS HOUSE IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: The Grey Healers opened a hospice in {nation}; fevers are falling.

minor_events.headline: WELLS CLEANSED IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: Water-wardens purified the town wells of {nation}.

minor_events.headline: A SONG ABOUT {nation} SWEEPS THE CONTINENT
minor_events.detail: Bards in every tavern are singing a ballad about {nation}'s generosity.

minor_events.headline: {nation}'S ENVOY CALMS A BORDER QUARREL
minor_events.detail: A {nation} envoy talked two quarrelling villages out of a feud.

minor_events.headline: FREE COMPANY ENLISTS WITH {nation}
minor_events.detail: A free company of mercenaries swore to {nation} for the winter, asking only bread.

minor_events.headline: {nation} RESTORES AN OLD FORTRESS
minor_events.detail: Stonemasons rebuilt a ruined hill fort on {nation}'s frontier.

minor_events.headline: GRIFFIN RIDERS RETURN TO {nation}
minor_events.detail: A wing of griffin riders, long abroad, returned home to {nation}.

minor_events.headline: GOOD OMEN OVER {nation}
minor_events.detail: A double rainbow over {nation}'s capital is taken as a blessing.

minor_events.headline: SUNKEN TREASURE RAISED BY {nation}
minor_events.detail: Divers of {nation} raised a merchant wreck full of silk bales.

minor_events.headline: HONEY YEAR IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: {nation}'s beekeepers report the best honey year in living memory.

minor_events.headline: RATS IN THE GRANARIES OF {nation}
minor_events.detail: Vermin spoiled part of {nation}'s grain store.

minor_events.headline: MOTH SICKNESS HITS {nation}
minor_events.detail: A blight among the silk moths reduces {nation}'s silk output.

minor_events.headline: CORE LEAK IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: An aether conduit cracked; engineers contained it, but cores were lost.

minor_events.headline: BREAD QUEUE UNREST IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: Long queues for bread led to scuffles in {nation}'s markets.

minor_events.headline: MARSH FEVER IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: A mild fever spreads through {nation}'s lowland villages.

minor_events.headline: DIPLOMATIC GAFFE BY {nation}
minor_events.detail: An envoy of {nation} insulted the host at a Spire banquet.

minor_events.headline: DESERTIONS IN {nation}'S ARMY
minor_events.detail: Hungry soldiers of {nation} slipped away from the frontier forts.

minor_events.headline: HAILSTORM OVER {nation}
minor_events.detail: Hail the size of plums flattened fields across {nation}.

minor_events.headline: MILDEW IN {nation}'S SILOS
minor_events.detail: Damp got into the silos of {nation}; part of the grain is mouldy.

minor_events.headline: CROW SWARMS DESCEND ON {nation}
minor_events.detail: Clouds of crows stripped the last standing crops of {nation}.

minor_events.headline: SMUGGLERS RAID {nation}'S WAREHOUSES
minor_events.detail: A smuggling ring emptied a warehouse of {nation} silk overnight.

minor_events.headline: {nation}'S SILK FALLS OUT OF FASHION
minor_events.detail: Spire courtiers have decided that {nation}'s silk patterns are passé.

minor_events.headline: FORGE FIRE IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: A forge fire gutted one of {nation}'s aether workshops.

minor_events.headline: SABOTAGE AT {nation}'S CORE WORKS
minor_events.detail: Someone jammed the pumps of {nation}'s core works. Nobody has claimed it.

minor_events.headline: TAX PROTEST IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: Townsfolk of {nation} refused to pay the new granary levy.

minor_events.headline: FIERY PREACHER STIRS {nation}
minor_events.detail: A wandering preacher in {nation} blames the famine on the government.

minor_events.headline: WINTER COUGH SPREADS IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: A hacking cough has kept many of {nation}'s workers in bed.

minor_events.headline: BAD WATER IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: A flooded well poisoned several districts of {nation}.

minor_events.headline: {nation} SPY CAUGHT AT THE SPIRE
minor_events.detail: A clerk of the {nation} delegation was caught copying Spire papers.

minor_events.headline: {nation} ACCUSED OF BROKEN PROMISES
minor_events.detail: Neighbours say {nation} quietly failed to deliver last year's aid.

minor_events.headline: RUST IN {nation}'S ARMOURIES
minor_events.detail: Damp armouries in {nation} left blades and mail rusted through.

minor_events.headline: OFFICERS FEUD IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: Two generals of {nation} fell out; their regiments refuse to drill together.

minor_events.headline: BRIDGE COLLAPSES IN {nation}
minor_events.detail: The old toll bridge of {nation} gave way; carts and goods were lost.

minor_events.headline: WOLF PACKS ROAM {nation}
minor_events.detail: Starving wolves are attacking flocks on {nation}'s uplands.

abyssal_chasm.name: The Abyssal Rift
abyssal_chasm.note: Attackers must fight in the dark.

verdant_lowlands.name: Soft lowland fields
verdant_lowlands.note: Flat farmland is hard to hold.

solar_plateau.name: Sunlit plateau
solar_plateau.note: A good view of the approach.

weather.name: Clear skies
weather.text: Clear skies: neither side has an advantage.

weather.name: Heavy rain
weather.text: Heavy rain turns the roads to mud and slows attackers.

weather.name: Dense fog
weather.text: Dense fog hides both armies from each other.
